name: Agnisys Technology Pvt. Ltd
capabilities: Agentic AI framework for semiconductor design
india_angle: Agnisys Technology Pvt. Ltd is based in India, focusing on semiconductor design automation solutions.
summary: Agnisys Technology Pvt. Ltd specializes in electronic design automation (EDA) tools and IP solutions for semiconductor design. Their offerings include AI-driven frameworks for specification to RTL sign-off, scalable NoC interconnect IPs, and a comprehensive suite for automated SoC development. They cater to markets such as AI, automotive, and multi-core systems.
